content.fortuneExplainFooter: This commentary supports the entertainment fortune — adjust to how you feel today.

keyword.pr: Today’s flow favors a careful PR attempt. Warm up thoroughly, then try a slightly higher challenge than usual.
keyword.dropSet: Today fits raising intensity in a set, then dropping weight for extra reps to change the stimulus.
keyword.superSet: Pairing two moves back-to-back can raise training density today.
keyword.volume: A good day to build volume with small bumps in sets or reps.
keyword.recovery: Prioritize how you feel over forcing intensity. If you train, keep it lighter than usual.
keyword.dumbbell: Dumbbells fit today’s flow — focus on balance and range of motion.
keyword.freeWeight: Free-weight stimulus fits today — add a barbell or dumbbell variation.
keyword.cardio: Light cardio and breathing rhythm fit better than max intensity today.
keyword.control: Control and quality of stimulus matter most — slow down and own the range.
keyword.leg: Lower-body work fits today — warm up well and check knees/hips as you go.
keyword.chest: Chest stimulus fits today — keep shoulders stable through your sets.
keyword.back: Back work fits today — cue scapular control on pulls.
keyword.default: Use today’s keyword as a light guide and apply one small change. Stable execution beats big jumps.

strategy.pyramid: Start lighter and build intensity set by set. Check condition as loads rise — quality over ego.
strategy.dropSet: After a hard set, drop weight and keep reps going. Stop before form collapses.
strategy.superSet: Link two moves with short rests. Extend rest if breathing gets ragged.
strategy.prChallenge: Warm up fully, then consider a harder attempt only on the last set.
strategy.volumeUp: Add a little volume via sets/reps rather than a big jump in load.
strategy.weightHold: Hold load steady and prioritize form and range.
strategy.slowControl: Move slowly through a full range and feel the stimulus.
strategy.highWeight: Warm up well, then use lower reps. Skip reckless max attempts.
strategy.default: Today’s strategy is {{strategy}}. Pick one goal — stimulus, quality, or volume — and execute.

content.strategyFooter: Strategies are guides; today’s condition matters more.
content.prHigh: A PR attempt may feel appealing — still weigh how you feel today.
content.prMid: Favor stable execution and set quality over big jumps.
content.prLow: Prioritize owning current loads and movement quality over chasing a new max.
content.prDisclaimer: PR luck does not guarantee a result.
content.recoveryHigh: Run your usual routine and still protect post-workout recovery.
content.recoveryMid: Balance intensity with recovery as you set today’s pace.
content.recoveryLow: Keep intensity measured today and protect recovery as part of the session.
content.avoidBody: Ease off 「{{avoid}}」 today. If you want stimulus, change sets, reps, or tempo instead.
content.avoidFooter: A pacing cue — not a hard warning.
content.try1: Start the first move with enough prep sets.
content.try2: Don’t jump load on set one.
content.try3: Apply today’s suggested style ({{style}}) at least once.
content.try5: Save today’s workout log when you finish.
